text:
Ava (PM): Quick sync: we need final GA gating criteria for Ship v1 by EOD Friday. Main buckets: uptime SLA, latency bands, burst billing guardrails, fallback routing behavior, runbooks/docs. Call out any hard blockers now.

Leo (Eng): Uptime: we can guarantee 99.9% per-route for standard customers. For latency, propose three p95/p99 bands: <500ms (light), 500-1500ms (medium), >1500ms (heavy LM). Heavy LM routes will be explicitly labeled.

Sam (SRE): Trace/telemetry retention for GA: 7 days of full traces + 90d of aggregates. Also propose an operational alert: if fallback_ratio > 0.05 for 10m, page SRE + open incident channel.

Rina (FinOps): For burst billing, suggested model: committed_base + burst_multiplier with an hourly cap. Example to include in docs: "Customer with 4 reserved GPUs, bursts to 40 GPUs for 1 hour -> billing cap = 10x baseline_hour. Monthly worst-case = baseline_month + (num_burst_hours * capped_hourly_delta)." I'll put a worked token-based example in PR.

Noah (Support): Support tiers: GA support windows = business-hours for self-serve, 24/7 for paid enterprise with pager. Escalation flow: Support triages -> if infra/fallback suspected, page SRE; if billing anomaly, page FinOps. Need this flow documented in the public runbook.

Ava (PM): On fallback routing: what's the safest default? We want graceful degradation rather than erroring.

Leo (Eng): Default: soft-fallback to same-family quantized model (q4_0 or q4f16 depending on model) with notice. Also add hard-fallback to smaller architecture only if quantized variant is unavailable. We'll tag telemetry with fallback_reason: {capacity, timeout, model_unavailable}.

Sam (SRE): Add to runbook: customer-visible banner on fallback that links to FAQ; internal alert when fallback hits >1% of global requests for 5m. Also require a run:replay id to be captured for support investigations.

Ava (PM): Docs requirements: short banner wording, FAQ entry explaining quality variance, impact matrix mapping tier -> expected behavior (e.g., Free: may experience fallback and burst caps; Standard: limited fallback; Enterprise: reserved-only unless explicit overflow). Cannot GA without that matrix.

Rina (FinOps): Fine. I'll include a pair of worked examples: tokens/min -> cost delta and a worst-case monthly example. Would Product OK showing a sample invoice calc?

Ava (PM): Yes, an illustrative invoice calc is fine as long as it's explicit it's an example. Legal approved.

Leo (Eng): Implementation asks: feature flag to enable/disable fallback per-tenant + admin UI toggle (~2 dev-days), metrics + dashboard for fallback_reason + model_variant (~3 dev-days). We can deliver before pilot if prioritized.

Noah (Support): I'll own the customer-facing triage checklist and the impact matrix doc. I'll also add the short template for support replies when customers hit fallback behavior.

Sam (SRE): Monitoring: add 5m rolling p95/p99 by route, and a cost-forecast alert when projected monthly spend > 1.2x committed. Tie that alert to FinOps.

Ava (PM): Outstanding decisions: exact latency buckets wording, the fallback quality disclaimer text, and the numeric cap multiplier (Rina's example). Let's reconvene tomorrow 09:00 PST. Can Rina post the numeric examples tonight and Leo open the feature-flag PR?

Rina (FinOps): Posting examples tonight. I'll include the tokenized scenarios and invoice-style calc.

Leo (Eng): PR started: feature-flag branch + initial metrics. Marking WIP; ping when you need review.

Noah (Support): Draft triage doc uploaded to /docs/ga/ship-v1/support-triage.md (WIP).

docs-bot: created -> ./docs/ga/ship-v1/support-triage.md (stub)

Ava (PM): Final ask: add an explicit GA checklist entry that docs include an "operational impact matrix" mapping tiers to fallback behavior, monitoring thresholds, and billing caps. Will not sign GA off without it.

Sam (SRE): Noted. I'll add the alert/playbook items to staging.

Ava (PM): Thanks all. If there are no blockers by tomorrow 09:00 PST we treat this locked. :white_check_mark:

Leo (Eng): :+1:

Sam (SRE): :thumbsup:

Rina (FinOps): 44d

Noah (Support): 197
